intro.title: Introduction
intro.description:
A Python developer and DevOps engineer with 9+ years of experience building scalable, data-driven applications. I specialize in Flask-AppBuilder, Apache Superset, and AI-powered solutions using OpenAI and LangChain — from intelligent chatbots to automated data pipelines.

I'm an active open-source contributor, with pull requests merged into projects like Flask-AppBuilder, Chatwoot, and even CPython. My work spans the full stack — from crafting ReactJS frontends to architecting cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP using Terraform and Pulumi.

When I'm not shipping code, I'm exploring new ways to bridge AI with real-world business problems — whether it's building voice assistants, automating workflows, or turning raw data into actionable insights.

achievements: Developing Phelina a powerful AI for Data insights.
Create and maintain the Airflow DAGs for the data pipeline.
Maintain infrastructure on Azure and AWS.
Managed and maintained Linux servers and Azure cloud infrastructure.
Setup complete infrastructure for the new projects.
Managed and maintained Linux servers on client site.
Monitor daily and monthly backup of the servers.
